what: The open seat's value is 16 bytes (the UTF-8 of OPENSEAT-OPENSEA). Bo asks for it by the 16-character TEXT of the same bytes, Ada confirms him by that TEXT, and he moves naming it (B). A seat value is 16 bytes, and a TEXT is not one whatever its length: the confirm counts for nothing, Bo holds nothing, and his move is not admitted and is reported SEAT_NOT_HELD by the merge that takes it; no reader throws (A09). Before, a TEXT value matched the TEXT a seat row named, and one merge admitted the move and reported it (review 9, A09).
